# HTMX

The website self-hosts HTMX 2.0.11 from the upstream npm distribution.

- Source: https://cdn.jsdelivr.net/npm/htmx.org@2.0.11/dist/htmx.min.js
- Upstream: https://github.com/bigskysoftware/htmx
- License: Zero-Clause BSD (`LICENSE`)
- Bundled file: `website/src/main/resources/static/htmx-2.0.11.min.js`

The script is loaded with `defer`; the complete portfolio works before it loads.
